bugs.title: No debounce: bounce and noise toggle lamp multiple times per press
bugs.description: The loop reads the raw pin and calls flipLamp() on every HIGH-to-LOW transition (lines 50-56) with no settle window, so each bounce edge is treated as a new press. Measured evidence shows a single press toggling D11 6 times (press at 200 ms), 4 times under bounce (press at 1.00 s), and 3 times for rapid presses, plus 20 spurious toggles with no press at all starting at 402 ms. The spec requires a 40 ms settle window before accepting a press edge, which is entirely absent. 4 of 4 press(es) did not toggle D11 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [6, 6, 6, 6]. D11 also toggled 20 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 402 ms.
